name: Busa AI Newsroom
description: Daily industry-intelligence cockpit for AI/news-source intelligence: source-backed signals, buyer-intent interpretation, approved sales/operating actions, and channel drafts (sales opener / LinkedIn post / client memo) for review before any external handoff. Signals/actions/drafts enter Busabase only through the agent's own browsing-and-writing workflow (see SKILL.md); the AirApp itself is read/decision-only.

agentPrompts.label: Give me today's newsroom overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-ai-newsroom` skill in this folder, then give me today's overview: needs-review, approved, and blocked counts, the top signals, and the ready actions.

agentPrompts.label: Walk me through today's review queue
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-ai-newsroom` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then walk me through today's signals, actions, and drafts awaiting a decision one at a time, and record the verdict I give for each. Never post, publish, or hand anything off outside Busabase yourself.
